facts.fact: It is free to register for an ABN through the Australian Business Register. A complete online application shows the outcome on completion; reviews can take 20 business days. An ABN does not replace your tax file number.
You are not entitled to an ABN for work done as an employee, even if it is called contracting. An employer should not ask you to get an ABN as a condition of employment.

An ABN requirement in a job ad does not mean you will automatically be an independent contractor; a business cannot just decide to treat you as one, and the tax and super obligations stay with the business.
Condition 8547 (six month limit) applies to any type of work; for self-employed people the employer for 8547 purposes is the end user.
Working holiday maker rates: 15% on the first $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, 45% above; no tax-free threshold. Effective 1 July 2026, unchanged from 2025-26.
GST registration threshold: $75,000 annual turnover; taxi travel and ride sourcing must register from the first fare.
Superannuation Guarantee 12% of ordinary time earnings, unchanged for 2026-27.
